scope: EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma TN/MRD/PD metadata and expression analyses
interpretation: These are research signatures, not clinical predictors or treatment rules.
panel_constraint: Gene membership was checked against the GSE342824 Xenium panel where applicable.

egfr_mapk_resistance.role: EGFR bypass and MAPK signaling context

analysis_rules: Freeze gene lists before outcome analysis.
Require at least three detected genes for a sample-level signature score.
Report the number of detected genes and missing genes for every score.
Do not calculate gene-expression scores from metadata-only files.
Do not treat cells as independent patients.
Do not map a signature score directly to treatment advice.
